def VTask.evenOddRec : {P : ℕ → Sort u_1} → (h0 : P 0) → (h_even : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n)) → (h_odd : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n + 1)) → (n : ℕ) → P n :=
  fun P h0 h_even h_odd n =>
    let f : ℕ → Sort u_1 := P
    let h₁ : f 0 := h0
    let h₂ : ∀ (n : ℕ), f n → f (2 * n) := h_even
    let h₃ : ∀ (n : ℕ), f n → f (2 * n + 1) := h_odd
    -- Use strong induction to define the function
    have h₄ : ∀ n : ℕ, f n := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h n ih =>
        match n with
        | 0 => exact h₁
        | n + 1 =>
          have h₅ : (n + 1) % 2 = 0 ∨ (n + 1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
          cases h₅ with
          | inl h₅ =>
            -- Case: n + 1 is even
            have h₆ : ∃ k, n + 1 = 2 * k := by
              use (n + 1) / 2
              have h₇ : (n + 1) % 2 = 0 := h₅
              have h₈ : 2 * ((n + 1) / 2) = n + 1 := by
                have h₉ := Nat.div_add_mod (n + 1) 2
                omega
              linarith
            obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h₆
            have h₇ : k < n + 1 := by
              have h₈ : 2 * k = n + 1 := by linarith
              have h₉ : k < n + 1 := by
                by_contra h₁₀
                have h₁₁ : k ≥ n + 1 := by omega
                have h₁₂ : 2 * k ≥ 2 * (n + 1) := by
                  nlinarith
                have h₁₃ : 2 * k > n + 1 := by nlinarith
                linarith
              exact h₉
            have h₈ : f k := ih k h₇
            have h₉ : f (2 * k) := h₂ k h₈
            have h₁₀ : f (n + 1) := by
              rw [hk] at *
              exact h₉
            exact h₁₀
          | inr h₅ =>
            -- Case: n + 1 is odd
            have h₆ : ∃ k, n + 1 = 2 * k + 1 := by
              use (n + 1) / 2
              have h₇ : (n + 1) % 2 = 1 := h₅
              have h₈ : 2 * ((n + 1) / 2) + 1 = n + 1 := by
                have h₉ := Nat.div_add_mod (n + 1) 2
                omega
              linarith
            obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h₆
            have h₇ : k < n + 1 := by
              have h₈ : 2 * k + 1 = n + 1 := by linarith
              have h₉ : k < n + 1 := by
                by_contra h₁₀
                have h₁₁ : k ≥ n + 1 := by omega
                have h₁₂ : 2 * k ≥ 2 * (n + 1) := by
                  nlinarith
                have h₁₃ : 2 * k + 1 > n + 1 := by nlinarith
                linarith
              exact h₉
            have h₈ : f k := ih k h₇
            have h₉ : f (2 * k + 1) := h₃ k h₈
            have h₁₀ : f (n + 1) := by
              rw [hk] at *
              exact h₉
            exact h₁₀
    exact h₄ n
